context: Mixed-scale parallel coordinates chart showing 300 synthetic employees across 6 dimensions: Age (linear), Experience (linear), Salary (log), Department (ordinal point), Education (ordinal point), Performance (linear 1-5).
first_impression: Well-constructed parallel coordinates with appropriate scale choices per dimension and canvas-based rendering, labeled and color-coded by department.
what_works: Log scale correctly applied to log-normally distributed salary data and explicitly labeled 'log scale'; most domains are data-driven via d3.extent/d3.max rather than magic numbers, and ordinal dimensions use scalePoint correctly.
what_doesnt: Age uses d3.extent causing potential axis jump on subset (removing the min/max employee shifts the scale); experience max is data-driven but could also jump, making relative comparisons unstable across filter interactions — hardcoded bounds matching generation constraints [22,63] and [0,38] would be more robust.
